ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, on the number line, points $C$ and $D$ divide the line segment $AB$ into three parts in the ratio $2:5:3$, with $E$ being the midpoint of $AB$. If $ED=3\,cm$, what is the length of the line segment $AB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} From the given information, \\
since $E$ is the midpoint of $AB$, \\
thus $EB=\frac{1}{2}AB$, \\
since points $C$, $D$ on the number line divide the segment $AB$ into three parts in the ratio $2:5:3$, \\
thus $BD=\frac{3}{2+5+3}AB=\frac{3}{10}AB$, \\
thus $ED=EB-BD=\frac{1}{2}AB-\frac{3}{10}AB=\frac{1}{5}AB$, \\
also, since $ED=3\text{cm}$, \\
thus $\frac{1}{5}AB=3\text{cm}$, \\
thus $AB=\boxed{15\text{cm}}$.
